36. 若 $\beta$ 為一實數，則 $\frac{\beta^2 + 4}{\beta + 2i} =$

A. $\beta - 2i$
B. $\beta + 2i$
C. $2 - \beta i$
D. $2 + \beta i$
reasoning: The numerator can be rewritten as a difference of squares: $\beta^2 + 4 = \beta^2 - (2i)^2 = (\beta + 2i)(\beta - 2i)$. Substituting this into the fraction, we get $\frac{(\beta + 2i)(\beta - 2i)}{\beta + 2i} = \beta - 2i$.
